instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In an indoor boxing gym, the man with a braided mohawk and beard in a black t-shirt (R2) stands on the left in profile, facing right. He guides the woman with braided hair in a black strapless top (R1), who stands on the right wearing black boxing gloves. The man (R2) holds the top of her glove with his right hand to adjust her stance, while she looks forward with a calm expression. In the blurred background, a single bystander in dark clothing stands near a black punching bag. Bright overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
